- **"Understanding the Security Implications of AI-Generated Code" (Smith et al., 2023)**: This paper provides an in-depth analysis of the specific security risks associated with using AI for code generation and offers mitigation strategies.

The novelty claim of the SecureCodeAgent framework appears defensible, focusing on the comprehensive integration of vulnerability-aware verification and provenance tracking in AI-assisted coding environments.
